**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/25 (Thu) 08:29

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended an ordered list of lead guitar solos to learn to build technique towards playing the solo to "Tornado of Souls."

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. "Sunshine of Your Love" by Cream - Develops bending and vibrato technique.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. "Stairway to Heaven" by Led Zeppelin - Develops phrasing and dynamics.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. "Comfortably Numb" by Pink Floyd - Develops bending, vibrato, and sustain techniques.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. "Cemetery Gates" by Pantera - Develops sweeping, tapping, and legato techniques.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. "Cliffs of Dover" by Eric Johnson - Develops alternate picking, legato, and arpeggio techniques.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. "Satch Boogie" by Joe Satriani - Develops alternate picking, sweep picking, and legato techniques.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. "For the Love of God" by Steve Vai - Develops bending, vibrato, and legato techniques.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. "Eruption" by Van Halen - Develops tapping, legato, and tremolo bar techniques.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. "Technical Difficulties" by Racer X - Develops sweep picking, alternate picking, and legato techniques.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. "Tornado of Souls" by Megadeth - Requires mastery of many advanced techniques; recommended to start with rhythm parts and gradually work up to the solo.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Advised to practice each solo at a comfortable tempo before increasing speed, focusing on good technique, clean and accurate playing.

[USER] Asked if "Cliffs of Dover" as a whole may be more difficult to learn on guitar than "Tornado of Souls."

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Stated that "Cliffs of Dover" is generally considered more technically challenging than "Tornado of Souls."

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Explained that "Cliffs of Dover" features a wide range of techniques including alternate picking, sweep picking, legato, bending, vibrato, and tapping, along with challenging chord progressions and intricate rhythms.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Mentioned that "Tornado of Souls" focuses more on speed and precision with alternate picking, sweep picking, and string skipping techniques.

[USER] Inquired why "Cliffs of Dover" was recommended before "Tornado of Souls" if it is more technically challenging.
